summary: Hernandez is assessed as shielding Israel on the strength of a Hindu American PAC endorsement from a Hindutva-aligned group and $825,000 in independent super-PAC spending from AIPAC-backed United Democracy Project, joined by $1.84 million from BOLD America, a UDP-funded PAC. At an April 2026 Indivisible Tri-Valley forum she declined to call Israel's Gaza actions genocide, diverging from the Alameda County Democratic Party. Her campaign platform contains no statement on Palestine or Israel.
